key_points: Honeywell raised its 2026 outlook, signaling stronger revenue and earnings expectations
Launch of Forge Plant Cognition AI platform and connected cabin automation highlights growth in high‑margin software/AI services

Overall narrative shifts toward a more growth‑oriented, AI‑enabled positioning for Honeywell
